title: The Pressed Flower in the Book
youtube_title: The Pressed Flower in the Book | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Leaving a cover on is a kind of trust.
summary: At a quiet craft corner with paper, paste, and a wooden rack, Violeta wants to check on a pressed flower newly shut inside a heavy book before it is ready. With Auntie Luz nearby, Violeta leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
